card.name: Verb after a completed-event subject
card.fires_on: The helper word right after a subject like injection, toxicity, contents or patient, such as has, have or no longer, in instructions about waiting for a step to finish.

modes.label: has/have after subject
modes.description: A form of has or have follows a noun for a procedure or condition, leading into a past participle like finished or resolved.
modes.example: this tells you the injection<< has>> finished.

modes.label: Other waiting-for-state words
modes.description: Words like longer, as or to that follow a subject and set up a condition on when to proceed.
modes.example: when ALT/AST are no<< longer>> elevated

card.plain: It fires on the small word after a subject when the text says to wait until something has finished or changed.
